name: Hide All Notification Panel
author: Mutt Group / Mutt Studio

sections.description:
Hide All Notification Panel allows you to hide all WordPress admin notifications with a simple toggle.
This is particularly useful to keep the admin panel clean and distraction-free for all users.

Features:
– Hide all notifications from the WordPress admin area.
– Enable or disable the functionality via a simple toggle in the settings.
– Multi-language support: English and Portuguese (pt_BR).

Author: muttgroup

A brief Markdown Example

Here’s a simple example of what this plugin can do:

  1. Clean up your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Simplify admin tasks by removing distractions.
  3. Enable or disable the feature at any time.

Contributed by Mutt Studio
Thank you for supporting us! ❤️
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Hide Notifications to enable or disable the feature.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

This plugin hides all notifications that usually appear in the WordPress admin dashboard.

Can I turn this feature on and off?

Yes! A simple toggle is available under Settings > Hide Notifications.

Is it compatible with multilingual sites?

Yes, the plugin supports both English and Portuguese (pt_BR) languages.
